verdict.description: Your independent verdict on the worker's claimed severity.

severity.description: The severity YOU assign after independent analysis.

reasoning.description: Why. Cite the saved artifacts and impact that decide the verdict. As a tools-denied reviewer you never imply reproduction or that live checks were performed.

independent_checks.description: Observations the saved evidence must still provide to confirm the claim. You perform no live checks; empty array if none are needed.

exploitability.description: Realistic exploitability / preconditions / blast radius. Empty string if unknown.

vrt_node.description: The single most specific taxonomy node the proven differential supports, for example server_security_misconfiguration > rce.

vrt_version.description: The pinned taxonomy release the node was read from, when known.

cvss_vector.description: CVSS v4.0 base vector filled from proven facts only.

cvss_score.description: CVSS v4.0 score for the supplied vector; never converted directly into the P level.

cvss_severity.description: CVSS qualitative rating for the supplied vector.

severity_basis.description: Which precedence rule decided the severity: vrt_default, cvss_override, or program_adjustment, with the deciding rule.

evidence_chain_ack.description: Echo of the dossier's evidence chain id exactly as supplied; empty string when absent.

artifact_checklist.description: Per-claim review ledger keyed to saved artifacts; empty array when no claims are itemized.

claim.description: The assessed claim in safe abstracted wording.

satisfied.description: Whether the saved evidence proves the claim.

proving_artifact_ids.description: Artifact or flow IDs that prove the claim; empty when unsatisfied.

failing_or_missing_artifact_ids.description: Artifact or flow IDs that contradict the claim or are missing; empty when satisfied.
